answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the saffron log exposes the live set and the dune audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 600 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 240 aliases alive hence means 240 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the pulse quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
